a bipedal robot positioned on a support surface in an upright state
a motion system for moving the bipedal robot on the support surface with omnidirectional movements
a sensor assembly monitoring the bipedal robot

the motion system comprises devices provided on the bipedal robot or provided as part of a holotile floor system that includes the support surface
the bipedal robot is operable concurrently with the motion system to provide side-to-side motion

the sensor assembly comprises at least one of an inertial measurement unit (IMU) mounted on the bipedal robot, an optical tracker mounted on the bipedal robot combined with an optical sensor for generating the sensor data, and a magnetic tracker mounted on the bipedal robot combined with a magnetic sensor for generating the sensor data
the controller processes the sensor data to determine an angular rate for the bipedal robot
the controller generates the control signals when the angular rate is greater than zero
the motion system comprises a floor system providing omnidirectional movement of the bipedal robot and wherein the floor system includes

a plurality of disk assemblies, wherein each of the disk assemblies includes a contact disk with an upper contact surface supported at a tilt angle relative to horizontal whereby the contact disk has a raised portion for supporting the bipedal robot
a drive system comprising a disk orienting mechanism and a disk rotation mechanism for each of the disk assemblies

during each operating period, a floor system controller first operating the disk orienting mechanism for each of the disk assemblies to orient the contact disk to set a location of the raised portion and second operating the disk rotation mechanism for each of the disk assemblies to rotate the contact disk about a rotation axis at a rotation rate, whereby the floor system provides the stabilizing movements
the motion system comprises a floor system comprising

a plurality of active tiles each comprising a plurality of disk assemblies, wherein each of the disk assemblies includes a contact disk supported at a tilt angle whereby the contact disk has a raised portion for contacting the bipedal robot

a drive system for each of the active tiles, wherein the drive system of at least one of the active tiles first operates to orient the contact disks of the plurality of disk assemblies in the at least one of the active tiles to set a location of the raised portion and second operates to rotate each of the contact disks of the plurality of disk assemblies at a rotation rate about a rotation axis, wherein the rotation axes of the disk assemblies in the at least one of the active tiles are parallel
